description.p: A native replacement for Keychron Launcher, which only runs in Chromium-based browsers because it depends on WebHID. Firefox does not implement WebHID, so this app talks to the keyboard's raw HID interface directly instead.

ul.li: Remap any key on any layer, and put it back the way it shipped
Record and edit the keyboard's macro slots
Set the backlight effect, brightness, speed and colour
Test every switch, read live from the keyboard's own matrix
Save the whole configuration to a JSON file and load it back

description.p: It runs only when you open it. There is no daemon, no autostart entry and no background service.

First release. Key remapping across all layers, macro editing, backlight control, a key tester and configuration import/export, with a bundled definition for the Keychron K13 Max in all four variants.
